plaatsen.tekst: And great multitudes came unto him, having with them those that were lame, blind, dumb, maimed, and many others, and cast them down at Jesus' feet; and he healed them:
It were better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and he cast into the sea, than that he should offend one of these little ones.
